title.en: Thorough clinical updates with administrative friction

text.en: Pet parents highlight that veterinarians communicate promptly and thoroughly, calling back quickly after vaccination reactions and following up after emergency hospital visits. Conversely, online interactions and administrative policy disputes led to friction for some reviewers, making overall communication ratings mixed.

Clients frequently commend Dr. Askari, Dr. Toprak, and the clinical support staff for their kindness, deep medical expertise, and passionate approach. Reviewers appreciate that doctors take the time to answer questions without rushing, staying late when needed to demonstrate insulin injection techniques.

title.en: Gentle handling for complex medical cases

text.en: Reviewers praise the veterinary team for their gentle, reassuring manner with pets requiring ongoing chronic care, such as senior dogs diagnosed with diabetes. Pet owners note that clinicians handle pets experiencing fear-based reactivity with patience and understanding, putting anxious animals at ease.

q.en: How does the clinic handle after-hours pet emergencies?

a.en: The hospital refers urgent emergencies outside opening hours to the Veterinary Emergency Clinic or CTVRC.
Yes, clients report that the clinic has accommodated urgent same-day visits for pets experiencing sudden health changes.

q.en: Are the veterinarians supportive with chronic condition management?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that veterinarians stayed late to demonstrate how to administer insulin injections and manage ongoing illnesses.

q.en: Does the clinic follow up with patients after treatment?

a.en: Yes, pet owners praise staff for calling to check on their pets following vaccinations or emergency hospital visits.
